answer: Sybil resistance can rest on payment-instrument uniqueness: each agent identity binds one verified bank account or card, proven by a micro-deposit and card-network attestation. One instrument, one identity. An attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must open a thousand accounts, each carrying KYC checks, fees, and fraud monitoring, while an honest agent pays once. Shared instruments flag a cluster, and a whisper of suspicion triggers re-verification that slashes every linked stake. Like an island with one guarded causeway, the vault stays open to newcomers, yet mass forgery is uneconomic.
